claim.reason: North elevation (and matching South/East labels) show, below the F1/F2 floor line, a vertical dimension chain of 400/1600/1000 mm reading top-to-bottom from the floor line (absolute z=3.0m) down to ground. The middle 1600mm segment is the standard F1 office window (all typical single windows on north, south offices b/c, and east corridor). Segment index 1 (0-based) of a chain starting at origin 3.0m walking down (direction -1) gives absolute z=[1.0,2.6]m, matching the built [1.007,2.605].

decision.reason: Dimension chain matches built window family within 7mm; confirms independent elevation evidence for F1 typical windows.
